jobs.occupation: International Logistics Specialist (Import/Export) (m/f/d) (Kaufmann/-frau - Groß- und Außenhandel (Außenhandel))
jobs.description:
About us Die European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
ist das Joint Venture von TSMC, Bosch, Infineon und NXP. Erstmals
errichtet der weltweite Technologieführer TSMC eine Halbleiterfabrik
im Herzen Europas, die kleinste Fertigungstechnologien für
Halbleiterprodukte der nächsten Generation bietet. ESMC steht für
das gemeinsame Engagement zur Stärkung des europäischen
Halbleiter-Ökosystems. Für unsere zukünftige Fab in Dresden suchen
wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und engagierte/n: International Logistics
Specialist (Import/Export) (m/f/d) At ESMC, we are building a
state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in Dresden. As part of our
international Supply Chain organization, you will play a key role in
establishing efficient global logistics processes that ensure the
reliable movement of materials, equipment and goods across
international borders. This position offers the opportunity to shape
logistics processes from the ground up in an international greenfield
environment while working closely with colleagues, logistics providers
and customs authorities around the world. Tasks Manage international
import and export shipments for the Dresden fab and related locations.
Coordinate daily logistics operations together with freight forwarders
and logistics service providers. Support customs clearance activities
and ensure compliant import and export processes. Review
logistics-related invoices and payment processes within SAP. Monitor
logistics service providers against agreed KPIs and support continuous
performance improvements. Collaborate closely with internal
departments, suppliers, customs authorities and international
logistics partners. Support the implementation and harmonization of
global logistics processes and systems. Identify opportunities to
improve logistics, customs and global trade processes in a rapidly
growing manufacturing environment. Contribute to establishing scalable
logistics structures within our greenfield project. Profile Required:
Bachelor’s or Master´s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain
Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a
comparable qualification. Several years of professional experience
(approximately 7+ years) in international logistics, import/export,
customs or global trade. Strong knowledge of customs regulations and
international import/export processes. Practical experience
coordinating international shipments. Experience working with customs
brokers, freight forwarders and logistics providers. Strong
communication skills and experience working with international
stakeholders. Fluent German and good English skills. Nice to have:
Experience within semiconductor, electronics, automotive or other
manufacturing industries. Experience with SAP, ideally SAP S/4HANA.
Knowledge of export control regulations. Mandarin language skills. We
offer Help build a completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in
Europe. Work in a highly international environment with colleagues
across Europe, Taiwan and the US. Shape logistics processes instead of
maintaining existing structures. Participate in global projects and
cross-functional collaboration. International onboarding including
4–6 weeks of training in Taiwan and Arizona. Additional contact
details Please apply with your English resume. The ESMC recruiting
team will get in touch with you if your candidacy fits the hiring
criteria.

jobs.occupation: Scientific Project Coordinator (f/m/x) Environmental Data and AI Platform (DataMon) (IT-Projektkoordinator/in)
jobs.description:
© Kletr / Fotolia The Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research
(UFZ) is a world-leading institution in environmental research and a
member of the Helmholtz Association, Germany’s largest scientific
organisation. With approximately 1,200 employees across Leipzig,
Halle, and Magdeburg, we have been conducting research since 1991
using a transdisciplinary approach to address the most pressing
challenges of our time: biodiversity loss, climate change, and
environmental pollution. Our goal is to translate excellent research
into practical solutions for policymakers, business, and society, and
to serve as a reliable partner in supporting transformation processes
toward a sustainable and just future for current and future
generations. We foster a culture of collaboration, openness, and
diversity within a work environment that actively promotes creativity
and personal development. Scientific Project Coordinator (f/m/x)
Environmental Data and AI Platform (DataMon) The job DataMon is a new
strategic UFZ initiative to build an integrated environmental data and
AI platform that brings together established monitoring products,
scientific data services and cross-domain analytical capabilities. The
platform will make UFZ data products more accessible, interoperable
and AI-ready, while creating new opportunities for integrated
environmental research and knowledge transfer. As Scientific Project
Coordinator, you will play a central role in turning this ambitious
interdisciplinary initiative into a coherent implementation process,
connecting scientific, technical and organisational perspectives
across UFZ and with external partners. Your tasks Establish and
maintain the integrated DataMon roadmap across the shared platform,
monitor and data-product modules, and cross-cutting AI and
spatial-computing services. Work closely with module leads to clarify
requirements, resolve dependencies and conflicts, prepare decisions,
agree on priorities and next steps, and ensure consistent follow-up
across the DataMon portfolio. Coordinate milestones, deliverables,
dependencies, resource requirements, risks and decisions across module
leads, research data management, IT, knowledge transfer, research
infrastructure units, technical working groups and external service
providers. Translate scientific and user needs into clear technical
and organisational requirements, identify reusable solutions and
synergies across modules, and align priorities, interfaces and
implementation pathways. Prepare and facilitate Steering Group
meetings, readiness reviews and cross-project workshops; draft
decision papers and ensure that agreed actions are followed up and,
where necessary, escalated. Establish and maintain project controls
for schedules, risks, changes, decisions, reporting and documentation,
and prepare concise status and management reports. Support the
procurement and commissioning of external development services,
coordinate service providers, and monitor deliverables, acceptance
criteria and knowledge transfer in close cooperation with the
responsible UFZ units. Coordinate the transition from project
implementation to sustainable operation, including responsibilities,
update cycles, quality assurance, maintenance requirements and user
support. We offer The freedom to master even the most demanding
challenges between basic research and practical application The chance
to work in interdisciplinary, international teams and benefit from a
variety of perspectives First class integration into national and
international research networks to work together on global challenges
Excellent research infrastructure and research data management to
optimally support your work Flexible working hours and a wide range of
options for balancing work and care responsibilities through our
family office Competent support and advice for international
colleagues arriving at the UFZ from the 'International Office' Special
annual payment, capital-forming benefits and subsidised Germany Job
Ticket A workplace in a vibrant region with a high life quality and
social and cultural diversity Your profile An academic degree at
master’s level or equivalent in environmental or natural sciences,
computer or data science, geoinformatics, engineering, science and
technology management, or a related field Several years of experience
managing complex, interdisciplinary digital, research-infrastructure,
software or data-platform projects, including multi-team roadmaps,
deliverables, dependencies, risks and reporting Proven ability to lead
through influence, create commitment across organisational boundaries,
address conflicts constructively, prepare and facilitate decisions,
and ensure consistent follow-up A strong technical understanding of
data platforms and software development, interfaces and APIs, data and
metadata workflows, FAIR principles, cloud or compute environments,
and AI-enabled services. Hands-on coding experience is welcome, but
not essential Excellent facilitation, presentation, negotiation and
writing skills, with the ability to communicate confidently with
researchers, IT specialists, management, stakeholders and external
service providers A structured, independent and outcome-oriented
working style, sound judgement in evolving and complex project
settings, and experience with agile or hybrid project management
approaches Very good written and spoken English and German Experience
with public procurement, contract deliverables or external service
provider management is an advantage The UFZ values diversity and is
actively committed to ensuring equal opportunities for all employees,
regardless of their origin, religion, beliefs, disability, age or
sexual identity. We welcome people who represent diverse backgrounds,
identities and perspectives. We therefore particularly encourage
people who are affected by structural discrimination to apply to us.

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Facilities Technician / Betriebstechniker (Electrical
Systems) (m/f/d) As Facilities Technician you are responsible for
operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting of electrical systems for
all power up to and including 110kV including Site Substations,
Service Entry Sections, Electrical switchgear, Panelboards,
Transformers, cabling systems, metering circuits, diesel generators,
uninterruptable power supply (UPS), Power Distribution Unit (PDU),
Remote Power Panel (RPP), and Static Transfer Switch (STS) as well as
motor connections, Motors and electrical controls. You play the
pivotal role to ensure standard operating procedures are followed
accurately and reliably to ensure our fab follows highest
environmental protection standards. By performing laboratory testing
and systematic verification and alignment of measurements from various
instruments, sensors, and equipment our fab can run smoothly thanks to
your work. Tasks Maintains a clean, orderly, and safe workplace,
follow all safety policies and procedures at all times and make
recommendations for continuous improvement of work method, safety,
materials-, and tool handling. Monitors operation of the mechanical /
electrical operating equipment. Observes gauges, signals and recording
instruments turns valves, moves controls to regulate temperatures,
pressures, flow of heating water, coolant to effectively monitor
critical limits. Performs standard diagnostics, monitor site
performance indicators and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for
interruptions or incidents. Performs troubleshooting, emergency and
corrective maintenance and repair actions. Performs diagnostic to
determine root cause and corrective actions needed to maintain systems
operation within specifications in conformity with plant standards.
Maintains log of gauge readings, shift throughput, and equipment
malfunctions. Patrols area to inspect equipment and record tank levels
and gauge readings. Ensures processing conditions and process output
are within regulatory limits and alerting management of discrepancies.
Perform standard and non-standard equipment maintenance, repairs and
modifications to ensure smooth operations inline with environmental
protection requirements. Profile Qualifications and Education:
Eligible to work in Germany and available for 3 months on-the-job
training in Taiwan. Technician or equivalent technical apprenticeship
education as electrician, in Mechatronics or a related field. Minimum
2–3 years of experience in a facilities, utilities, or electrical
related role. Qualified electrician to effectively detect and repair
defects in the operation of plant electrical equipment. Willingness to
work in a cleanroom environment with rotating shifts or on-call
duties. Deep interest in mechanical, chemical, and electrical
principles related to mechanical systems. Language Skills: Good
command of English with good command of German to communicate in our
international workplace. Professional Skills: Knowledge of industry
standards, codes and regulations, and the ability to apply to
maintenance operation of site Electrical systems. Functional level
knowledge of Electrical theory to troubleshoot and repair electrical
controls and electrical power distribution systems, complex procedures
pertinent to equipment and power distribution and wiring repair.
Operational knowledge of medium and high voltage cabling systems,
understanding the hazards associated with the specific class of system
voltage, and being able to mitigate these hazards through safe working
practices. Basic computer skills, ability to learn usage of standard
maintenance and process monitoring software. Able to read and
interpret technical manuals and process schematics. Capable of working
independently and cooperatively with other Technicians, Engineers, and
Managers with a strong attention to detail, documentation accuracy,
and problem-solving. Personal Attributes: Having strong values of
honesty, integrity and respect for others. We offer Each journey
starts with a first step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will
provide you with the unique opportunity to actively shape the future
of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your true potential
to the test. You will be working in a fast paced, international
startup environment whilst at the same time having access to the
experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most advanced
semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. You have ample
opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital Transformation,
and various advanced Facilities related topics, both in Taiwan and
other sites around the world. Behind the world’s most advanced
technology are real people with real passion. Our success is fueled by
our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust
(ICIC). At ESMC we believe in the power of inclusive leadership and
passion. We demonstrate this in our commitment to our people vision:
create an inclusive environment to inspire passion and enable the best
in YOU. It is the policy of ESMC to provide equal employment
opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, ethnic and
national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability,
race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender
identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status,
status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other
characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Additional

jobs.description:
About us Welcome to TOI TOI & DIXI! We are the world’s leading
provider of mobile sanitary solutions, with operations across Europe,
the USA and Asia. Our TOI TOI® and DIXI® brands are represented in
31 countries, supported by more than 5,400 employees worldwide. At TOI
TOI & DIXI, everyone has the opportunity to make an impact. Flat
hierarchies, short decision-making paths and an appreciative working
culture create space for new ideas, personal responsibility and
professional development. In this hybrid position, you will combine
two complementary roles: As IT Business Partner, you will be the
trusted advisor and primary IT contact for our business units in the
Czech Republic, Slovakia and Poland. As IT Project Manager, you will
lead and deliver international IT projects across the Group. Your Role
Act as the single point of contact between IT and business
stakeholders in the Czech Republic, Slovakia and Poland for all new
demands, projects and digital initiatives. Build strong relationships
with stakeholders at all levels, understand their requirements and
translate business needs into scalable, value-adding IT solutions
Identify opportunities for digitalisation and guide new demands from
initial concept through prioritisation and approval to successful
implementation Coordinate internal teams, external service providers
and vendors to deliver IT projects on time, within scope and within
budget Define project objectives, scope, resources and schedules in
close collaboration with all relevant business and IT stakeholders
Develop and maintain project plans and documentation, monitor progress
and performance, and provide transparent status reporting Manage
project risks, dependencies and changes to scope, schedule and costs,
escalating issues where necessary Align IT services and investments
with business priorities while continuously improving service quality
and measurable business value Keep stakeholders informed about project
delivery, service performance, innovations and emerging technologies
Contribute ideas on digital trends and responsible AI use that improve
processes and the way we work Maintain regular on-site contact with
our locations in the region and support international projects beyond
your assigned Business Partner scope Facilitate demand management,
prioritisation and alignment of business requirements within the Group
IT portfolio. Ensure that technology initiatives and IT investments
deliver measurable business value and support strategic objectives.
Your Profile A degree in Information Technology, Computer Science,
Business Administration or a comparable qualification Three to five
years of professional experience in a comparable position, ideally as
an IT Business Partner, IT Project Manager or Business Analyst Fluent
written and spoken English and at least one of Czech, Polish, or
Slovak are mandatory; German language skills are an advantage. Proven
experience in successfully managing IT projects and sound knowledge of
both project life cycle and systems development life cycle
methodologies A strong understanding of core business processes,
particularly in areas such as Finance, HR, Operations and Sales Broad
knowledge of current technologies and digitalisation trends, with the
ability to identify their potential business value Practical
experience with common AI tools, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot or
comparable generative AI assistants, and the ability to use them
responsibly in daily work Excellent analytical, organisational and
stakeholder-management skills, combined with a structured and
solution-oriented approach Strong client-facing and communication
skills, with the confidence to engage effectively with stakeholders
from the shop floor to C-suite level A client-focused, proactive and
self-driven mindset with the ability to build trust and long-term
relationships Willingness to travel regularly within the region and,
where required, internationally Experience with project management
tools such as Microsoft Project or Smartsheet is an advantage; PRINCE2
certification is a plus Your Benefits Hybrid modern working model:
Work from home or from our office in Ratingen (Germany) with flexible
working hours. Permanent employment contract: Enjoy job security with
a long-term commitment. Supplementary company health insurance:
Additional health benefits provided by the company. Comprehensive
onboarding and training: Benefit from an individual onboarding plan
and extensive induction training to ensure a smooth start. Continuous
development opportunities: Take advantage of advanced and additional
training courses. Employee well-being: Access our company health
management program and enjoy 30 days of annual vacation. Collaborative
culture: Thrive in an environment of open communication and
cooperation. Contact us TOI TOI & DIXI Group GmbH Magdalena Gutland
(Recruiting & HR-Marketing) Halskestr. 38 40880 Ratingen

Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) – Institute for Pharmacology and Toxicology
Ref.-Nr.  601-2026
Third-party funding

The Faculty of Medicine is an integral part of the Otto-von-Guericke-University Magdeburg and cooperates with the Magdeburg University Hospital A.ö.R. in research, teaching and patient care.

Your Responsibilities:

We are seeking two highly motivated Postdoctoral Research Fellows to join our team investigating the molecular and cellular organization of the nervous system using cutting-edge spatial transcriptomics approaches. The successful candidates will work at the interface of neuroscience, genomics, and computational biology to map gene expression patterns across brain tissue with spatial resolution, contributing to our understanding of neural circuit organization, development, and disease.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative, well-resourced research environment with access to state-of-the-art spatial profiling platforms (e.g., MERFISH, 10x Visium), advanced microscopy, and high-performance computing infrastructure.

Two positions are available with complementary focus:

- Position 1 — Experimental/Wet-lab focus: Designing and executing spatial transcriptomics experiments on neural tissue, including tissue preparation, probe design, imaging, and data generation
- Position 2 — Computational/Analytical focus: Developing and applying computational pipelines for spatial transcriptomic data analysis, including cell-type mapping, spatial statistics, and integration with single-cell/single-nucleus datasets

(Candidates with strong interest and skills spanning both areas are also encouraged to apply and may be considered for either position.)

Key Responsibilities:

- Design, plan, and conduct spatial transcriptomics experiments on neural tissue samples
- Analyze and interpret complex spatial and single-cell genomic datasets
- Collaborate with neuroscientists, computational biologists, and clinicians within and outside the group
- Present findings at lab meetings, seminars, and international conferences
- Prepare manuscripts for peer-reviewed publication
- Contribute to grant writing and mentoring of graduate/undergraduate students
- Maintain rigorous documentation and adhere to good research and data management practices

Your Profile:

Essential Qualifications:

- A PhD (completed or close to completion) in Neuroscience, Molecular/Cell Biology, Genomics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related field
- Demonstrated research productivity (peer-reviewed publications and/or preprints)
- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

For the experimental-focus position, in addition:

- Hands-on experience with molecular biology techniques (e.g., histology, immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, RNA-seq library prep)
- Experience with spatial transcriptomics platforms (e.g., Visium, MERFISH, Xenium, seqFISH) is highly desirable
- Experience with rodent or human brain tissue handling is a plus

For the computational-focus position, in addition:

- Strong programming skills (Python and/or R)
- Experience analyzing single-cell/single-nucleus RNA-seq or spatial transcriptomics data
- Familiarity with relevant packages/tools (e.g., Scanpy, Seurat, Squidpy, STUtility) and statistical/machine learning methods
- Experience with high-performance/cluster computing is a plus

We offer:

- Access to cutting-edge spatial transcriptomics and imaging technology
- A collaborative, interdisciplinary, and supportive research environment
- Funding and support to attend international conferences
- Opportunities for career development, mentoring, and grant-writing training
- Work and family in harmony: Through Klinikzwerge (https://kita.med.ovgu.de/) , childcare may be available, subject to availability
- Help protect the environment and enjoy discounted public transportation through a job ticket
- In addition, we offer a diverse range of sports and relaxation activities as part of our workplace health promotion program
- Onboarding: At the start of your employment, you will participate in our orientation program, where you will receive important information and training sessions

Terms and Conditions:

- **Salary: **The salary group E 13 according to “Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst der Länder” awaits you
- **Appointment: **The position is to be filled as a full-time position, with a workload of 2,5 years, starting on 2027/01/01
- Work Location: Otto-von-Guericke-Universität Magdeburg, Medizinische Fakultät, Leipziger Str. 44, 39120 Magdeburg
- **Application Deadline: **2026/10/31

For further questions, please contact Mrs. Dr. Julia Rödiger at julia.roediger@med.ovgu.de

jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.

The Position
Are you passionate about innovation, finding cutting-edge solutions and creating value where it matters, around the globe? At the BI global Inflammation team, we strive to deliver innovative Therapeutic and patient centric solutions by putting the patient in the center of everything we do. We foster innovative thinking as well as an agile and collaborative way of working to advance our novel programs and capabilities in Therapeutic Area Inflammation.
The Global TA Inflammation, (Senior) HEOR  Manager, brings technical expertise, driving Outcomes Research (HEOR) and Patient Related Outcomes fostering our patient centric drive. His/she will support the TA Market Access Head by providing oversight, direction, and functional support on HEOR & PRO & Access projects. He/she will be working closely with Value and Evidence Networks within our Global Business Unit and with external stakeholders.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you develop and execute on health economics outcomes research (HEOR) & PRO strategies, demonstrating the medical and economic payer-relevant needs to optimize value of BI products.
- In this function, you generate evidence that secures optimal market access, successful HTA assessments, optimal pricing, reimbursement and formulary listing for BI products on a global scale.
- Additionally, you ensure insights to further inform development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), clinical development plan of our pipeline compounds.
- In consideration of regulatory body request and trial development, pre and post launch you will ensure relevant and new patient-reported outcome (PRO) measurement strategies to ensure that the patient perspective is captured in our clinical trial program and interact with regulatory authorities, closely collaborating with other functions.
- Besides, you ensure efficient and timely development of key HEOR deliverables (i.e. payer value stories, payer engagement tools, GVDs, economic models, retrospective database analyses, indirect comparisons, real world evidence data) for assigned BI products.
- Finally, yet importantly, you develop and maintain relevant partnerships with payers, academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.

Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:

- You will define long-term global development strategies for the assets, in close collaboration with the global Marketing and global Medical counterparts, to ensure optimal patient access.
- In addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.

Requirements

- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health
- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO consulting or payer authorities
- Multiple years of direct experience undertaking Health Technology Assessments (HTA) & PRO including Evaluations for Regulatory and health authority interventions of pharmaceutical products
- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs
- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets
- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption
- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)
- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data
- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external context

Additional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:

- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities
- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis
- Strong track record in value generation, demonstration and/or communication
- Highly experienced in conducting health economics/outcomes research across multiple specialty disciplines (e.g. patient reported outcomes, health economic modelling, real world data generation)

Who We Are 🌍

Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.

We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team.

What You'll Do 🔧

Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer.

- Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production
- Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour.
- **Make throughput a design decision:**Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment.
- **Ship modules, not scripts:**Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers.
- Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements.

What You Bring 🕵️

- Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures.
- Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain.
- Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing.
- Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it.
- Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike.

Why Limatica 🚀

- Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead.
- Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers.
- Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options.
- Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning
- Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card

What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us.

jobs.employer_name: ISR International School on the Rhine GmbH
jobs.description:
Position Overview

- Location: ISR International School on the Rhine, Neuss campus, with events at all ISR sites in Neuss, Düsseldorf, and Meerbusch
- Reports to: Head of Marketing 
- Employment type: Full-time
- Start date: as soon as possible

The Event Marketing Manager plans and delivers ISR's full event portfolio, from small community gatherings to large-scale events with up to 1,000 guests. Events are a core part of how ISR builds its community, attracts new families, and represents the school to universities, consulates, and partners. This role owns every event from concept to follow-up and supports the marketing team in day-to-day operations.

Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

Event planning and delivery

- Plan and run ISR’s internal and external events end to end, from community events, and consulate visits to university fairs, Open House and Info Days, the International Spring Festival, and cultural celebrations such as St. Martin’s Day, Halloween, Carnival, and Chinese New Year
- Build the annual event calendar in line with the academic year and admissions cycle
- Prepare run-of-show plans, manage events on site, and coordinate staff and volunteers
- Represent ISR at evening and weekend events, with compensatory time off according to school policy

Event communication and registrations

- Own all event communication from save-the-date to thank-you, and promote events across the website, social media, newsletters, and parent channels
- Set up and continuously monitor registrations, and follow up proactively with guests before and after each event
- Keep school leadership informed on registration numbers and hand over leads to the admissions team

Community and partnerships

- Work closely with school leadership, teachers, counselors, students, parents, and alumni, and host VIP and diplomatic guests
- Build long-term relationships with cooperation partners and sponsors, including co-hosted events, sponsorship packages, and internship formats with the University & Career Counseling team
- Maintain the partner database and identify opportunities for new partnerships

Budget and logistics

- Manage event budgets, permits, and licenses (e.g., GEMA), as well as the Marketing Storage Room
- Coordinate ISR’s US-style school bus for events, including scheduling, routes, and student supervision

Day-to-day marketing support

- Support the marketing team with content for the website, social media, and newsletters, as well as admissions campaigns
- Maintain marketing calendars and contact lists, and take on additional marketing tasks as needed

Qualifications and Experience

- Solid experience planning and running events, ideally including large events with several hundred guests or more
- Experience in an educational, nonprofit, or international setting, or in partnership management and sponsorship, is a plus
- Professional-level English and very good German skills
- Confident with Microsoft 365, AI tools, event registration tools, and social media
- Driver’s license
- Highly organized multitasker who can manage several events at once with close attention to detail
- Calm and solution-oriented under pressure and when plans change
- Friendly, professional, and poised presence with families, students, diplomats, and representatives
- Strong written communication skills and a proactive, reliable approach to follow-ups
- Intercultural awareness and genuine interest in a diverse school community
- Hands-on team player

At ISR, you will always be supported by committed, welcoming colleagues and confident, hardworking students. We eagerly anticipate witnessing your contributions to our vibrant educational community. In return, we are committed to providing you with a diverse array of opportunities for your professional growth and career development.

If the above description resonates with you, then please email your CV and cover letter to jobs@isr-school.de. (https://mailto:jobs@isr-school.de.)

jobs.occupation: Senior Data Engineer - Animal Health Clinical Development (m/w/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Tasks & responsibilities

- Act as a trusted partner to business stakeholders, translating business needs into scalable, sustainable technology and data solutions.
- Design, implement, and support Clinical Development data platforms and cloud-based data services across the Animal Health ecosystem.
- Enable efficient data acquisition, integration, transformation, analytics, and reporting through modern AWS-based solutions.
- Drive data interoperability, system integration, and enterprise-wide information exchange across clinical, regulatory, and business platforms.
- Implement DataOps, automation, and operational excellence practices to improve quality, scalability, efficiency, and user experience.
- Lead data governance, platform strategy, and the evolution of future data management capabilities, including metadata, semantic technologies, and interoperability frameworks.
- Collaborate with business, scientific, and IT stakeholders to identify opportunities, modernize technology landscapes, and deliver value-driven solutions.
- Provide technical leadership, project oversight, mentoring, and stakeholder engagement while ensuring compliance with enterprise architecture, security, and data standards.

Requirements

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Life Sciences Informatics or a related field or a Bachelor's degree with more relevant professional experience.
- Several years of professional experience in DataOps, Data Engineering, Data Integration, Clinical Systems, or Data Platform Engineering, preferably within pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences environments.
- Strong expertise in data modeling, data integration, and end-to-end data management processes.
- Hands-on experience with cloud-based data platforms and services, preferably AWS, including modern analytics solutions such as Snowflake or Databricks.
- Experience developing and supporting ETL/ELT pipelines, API integrations, and data interoperability solutions.
- Strong programming and scripting skills (Python preferred), along with experience in relational databases and data architecture concepts.
- Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or similar) and GxP-regulated environments, including data governance, quality, security, and compliance.
- Demonstrated project delivery, stakeholder management, communication, and teamwork skills, with a proactive, solution-oriented, and accountable mindset.
- Fluent English skills are required.

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

Please submit your application documents in English.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student (f/m/d) Charge-to-Spin Interconversion and Magnetotransport in Altermagnetic Thin Films (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
PhD Student (f/m/d) Charge-to-Spin Interconversion and Magnetotransport in Altermagnetic Thin Films

With cutting-edge research in the fields of ENERGY, HEALTH and MATTER, around 1,500 employees from more than 70 nations at Helmholtz-Zentrum Dresden-Rossendorf (HZDR) are committed to mastering the great challenges facing society today.

The Institute for Ion Beam Physics and Materials Research is dedicated to the study of materials and their nanostructures that can be considered for future applications in information technology and are based on electrical, magnetic or optical functionalities.

The Department of Magnetism is looking for a PhD Student (f/m/d) on Charge-to-Spin Interconversion and Magnetotransport in Altermagnetic Thin Films.

Your tasks

- Deposition and optimization of high-quality altermagnetic thin films and heterostructures
- Structural and magnetic characterization
- Investigation of magnetotransport phenomena and charge-to-spin interconversion
- Exploration of the fundamental spintronic properties of altermagnetic materials

Your profile

- Completed university studies (Master/Diploma) in the field of experimental physics or related field
- Background in eletric transport and magnetism
- Knowledge in thin film preparation and characterization techniques
- A collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for working in an international research team
- Proficiency in German and/or English

Our offer

- A vibrant research community in an open, diverse and international work environment
- Scientific excellence and extensive professional networking opportunities
- A structured PhD program with a comprehensive range of continuing education and networking opportunities - more information about the PhD program at the HZDR can be found here (https://www.hzdr.de/db/Cms?pNid=1908)
- Salary and social benefits in accordance with the collective agreement for the public sector (TVöD-Bund) including 30 days of paid holiday leave, company pension scheme (VBL)
- Depending on the personal qualifications, the candidate may be classified in salary group 13 according to TVöD-Bund
- We support a good work-life balance with the possibility of part-time employment, mobile working and flexible working hours
- Numerous company health management offerings
- Employee discounts with well-known providers via the platform Corporate Benefits
- An employer subsidy for the "Deutschland-Ticket Jobticket"

We look forward to receiving your application documents (including cover letter, CV, diplomas/transcripts, etc.), which you can submit via our online-application-system.

The TRR404 “Next Generation Electronics With Active Devices in Three Dimensions [Active-3D]” is a Collaborative Research Center/Transregio between TUD Dresden University of Technology and Rheinisch-Westfälische Technische Hochschule Aachen (RWTH Aachen) funded by Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft. The TRR aims at exploring a completely new approach for microelectronics technology and therefore teams up materialists, electrical engineers, and computer scientists of TUD, RWTH Aachen and Gesellschaft für Angewandte Mikro- und Optoelektronik mbH (AMO) in Aachen, Forschungszentrum Jülich (FZJ), Max Planck Institute of Microstructure Physics Halle (MPI-MSP), Nanoelectronic Materials Laboratory gGmbH (NaMLab) in Dresden, Ruhr-Universität Bochum (RUB).

For the initial funding phase (April 2025 – December 2028), the TRR404 offers several PhD and Postdoc positions with starting dates from April 1, 2025 onwards. All vacancies can be found here: https://cfaed.tu-dresden.de/trr-vacancies (https://cfaed.tu-dresden.de/trr-vacancies) .

For TUD diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.

At TUD the TRR404 offers, subject to the availability of resources, a full-time position as

Research Associate (m/f/x)

(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)

starting January 1, 2027. The position is limited to 24 months with the option of extension subject to further projects. The period of employment is governed by the Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). The position offers the chance to obtain further academic qualification. Balancing family and career is an important issue. The position is generally suitable for candidates seeking part-time employment. Please indicate your request in your application.

Position#5:              TRR404-TUD-B06

Project:                     B06 System Models, Architectures, and Application Mapping Tools 

Project Leader:    Prof. Jeronimo Castrillon (Chair of Compiler Construction)

Tasks:

The PhD student will be mostly in charge of modeling operations of emerging computing architectures, designing compiler abstractions, and working towards a programming framework for the 3D systems.

Requirements: 

- excellent university degree (Master/ diploma or equivalent) in computer science, mathematics, electrical engineering or a relevant area
- sound knowledge in C/C++ software development, experience in compilers (LLVM, MLIR) and automatic code optimization, knowledgeable in computer architecture
- above-average degree achieved in short study period
- willingness and ability to think beyond the boundaries of your field, to act in an international and diverse environment and to live an open and constructive communication
- strong analytic and problem-solving skills, creativity
- an independent, target- and solution-driven work attitude
- fluency in English, knowledge of German would be a plus

We offer:

A varied and challenging research task, embedded in a friendly, inclusive and supportive team of the TRR’s Principal Investigators (i.e., project leaders and supervisors). We maintain an open and cooperative work attitude with maximum personal responsibility, mutual support with a solution-oriented approach, and flexible working hours where possible. As a PhD student you will be integrated in the TRR’s Graduate School as well as becoming a member of the TUD’ Graduate Academy. Both will offer tailored educational programs and individual supervision agreements.

In addition, TUD offers: 

- employment in accordance with the provisions of the collective agreement for the public service of the Länder (TV-L)
- an individual assignment of the collective agreement experience level taking into account your previous professional experience
- 30 days annual vacation (based on a 5-day workweek) and annual bonus payment (restrictions apply)
- additional pension scheme (VBL)
- very good accessibility by public transport
- car parking facilities
- state-of-the-art buildings with labs equipped to a high technical standard
- a wide range of offers for health promotion and for the compatibility of family and career
- numerous opportunities for further training, including language courses, IT courses and other courses

TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment.

Application:

Please submit your detailed application with the usual documents including a motivation letter, CV, copy of degree certificate, transcript of grades (i.e., the official list of coursework including your grades) and proof of English language skills, by October 30, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de by sending it as a single pdf file quoting the reference number TRR404-TUD-B06 in the subject header to jeronimo.castrillon@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:jeronimo.castrillon@tu-dresden.de) or to:

TU Dresden, Chair of Compiler Construction, Prof. Jerónimo Castrillón, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.

Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.

TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.

Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .
